title: Install + wire firstmate (Phase 3 orchestration)
description: Install firstmate; set project mode no-mistakes with treehouse backend; enable SubagentStop matcher in loop-guard. Turns the manual one-agent loop into fan-out (one crewmate per package). See docs/agentic-workflow.md.

description: ml/sd live in ~/.bun/bin, not on non-interactive shell PATH; firstmate crewmates would silently no-op the ml/sd prime hooks. Ensure the env used for crewmate shells sources ~/.bun/bin. Blocks firstmate.

title: Slice A — Member discovery core (search → embedding-ranked results → creator profile)
description: Smallest shippable member slice, sits directly on the existing discovery substrate. A member (logged-in or -out) searches 'Search on Resonance', gets embedding-ranked creators, opens a full profile with offerings. Steps: (0) verify figma-console-mcp reaches ADR-0019 workflow parity (get_metadata/render/design-context equivalents) BEFORE relying on it — folds resonance-a011 doc-remap; (1) extend @resonance/db findSimilarProfiles with tag/role filters + status=ready + threshold + pagination, behind a small SWAPPABLE ranking seam / typed discovery contract (so scale experiments can retune without touching UI/actions) + a by-user/browse query; (2) discovery Server Action (Zod → resolveEmbedder().embed → filtered search), auth-optional; (3) @resonance/ui SearchBar + CreatorResultCard + results grid (tokens-only); (4) /discover session-optional route + re-target the explore intent from / to /discover; (5) render offerings on /creator/[id]; (6) promote AppNav into a shared authed layout (make Home/account icons live); (7) design.md for screen 07 + capture the search-results frame. title: Slice B — Member interests + personalized 'for you' feed
description:
Members pick interests (the counterpart to the creator interview) and land on a personalized feed.

SCOPE NOTE (2026-07-26, seed resonance-663d): the follows table, the follow/unfollow write path, and per-viewer follow-state resolution were pulled FORWARD into Slice A, because Slice A's designed creator-result row carries a Follow/Following control and shipping it dead was rejected in planning (plan pl-bbca, locked decision b). `@resonance/db` already exports `follows` (composite PK on (follower_id, following_id), migration 0003), `followCreator`, `unfollowCreator`, and `getFollowStates`. Do NOT re-create the table — the migration would collide. Slice B consumes that graph; it does not build it.

Steps: (1) @resonance/db member interests (reuse embeddings sourceType 'interest') + feed-assembly queries, reading the EXISTING follows table; (2) @resonance/community feed-assembly (currently only a Post schema; no commerce imports per ADR-0003); (3) lightweight member interest-picker onboarding (topic multi-select, embed as 'interest' to personalize) + /feed route using TanStack Query (the one sanctioned interactive-feed use, ADR-0008) + feed card composite; (4) new Figma frames (interest-picker, logged-in feed variant). Same swappable-ranking principle as Slice A applies to the personalized ranking. Depends on Slice A. Ships: a personalized member home.

title: Slice C — Commerce checkout + social posting (deferred separate vertical)
description: Turns offering DISPLAY into real transactions + adds the social layer. Deliberately carved off as its own vertical (large, self-contained), sequenced after Slices A+B prove the member surface. Scope: richer offering/product model (price cents, image slot, options — today's Offering is only {title,description}); cart + checkout + a real Stripe Connect adapter behind PaymentsPort (currently stubPayments throws, ADR-0006); post composer ('What's on your mind?') + likes + comments in @resonance/community; new frames (cart, checkout, post detail). title: Discovery ranking at scale — priority investigation (thresholds, filters, cold-start)
description: PRIORITY investigation flagged during member-vertical planning: findSimilarProfiles is proven only on a tiny corpus. As the creator corpus grows, empirically test + tune similarity thresholds, tag/role metadata filters (ADR-0010), ranking blend (interest vs query vs follows), and the cold-start story (few creators). ACCEPTANCE from the plan review: the Slice A/B implementation must keep ranking behind a small SWAPPABLE seam (query builder + thresholds isolated in @resonance/db behind a typed discovery contract) so these experiments can retune or replace ranking without touching UI or server actions. Explore + test as we move to scale.

title: figma: migrate design/manifest capture to read-only canonical Figma file + amend ADR-0019
description:
The design manifest cites node ids from a COPY of the designer's file, and REST is dead, so citations rot silently. See design/manifest/PROVENANCE.md for the full statement.

Current state (verified under resonance-80bf):
- FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN returns 403. Every REST-backed tool is unavailable: figma_get_file_data, figma_get_file_versions, figma_get_file_at_version, download_assets, get_screenshot, get_metadata. Figma version ids are therefore NOT obtainable, so captures cannot be version-pinned.
- The only working read path is the Desktop Bridge plugin (figma_execute / figma_capture_screenshot) against whatever file the plugin has open.
- Three file keys are in play: 7FOYLdtzCTITjcPeGKwF31 (original, Starter-tier, budget-capped), UYlkCL7jkCVgKWiqAVlEFp (Pro-team copy, source of screens 01-07 and what _index.md declared), vC0O5uyMmw1o5vYHmCoOXq 'Resonance (Copy)' (what the bridge is connected to, source of screens 08-12).
- Figma preserves node ids across a copy, so an id resolves in all three files forever. It never fails; it just quietly stops describing the frame the designer is now editing. Content hashing (the current mitigation) catches drift WITHIN a file but cannot catch drift BETWEEN files.

Target state:
1. Point the Desktop Bridge at the designer's CANONICAL file with view access.
2. Refresh FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN so REST version-pinning works again.
3. Version-pin every capture (record the Figma version id alongside the content hash).
4. Writes only ever to a file we own. This workflow only ever needs to READ Figma, so a copy buys nothing and costs citation integrity.
5. Demote 'Resonance (Copy)' to a cache; re-verify or re-capture screens 01-12 against canonical and drop the copy-derived flag.

6. AMEND ADR-0019 (docs/adr/0019-design-fidelity-visual-manifest.md). Deferred out of resonance-80bf deliberately, and flagged by that seed's no-mistakes document gate (finding document-1) as the remaining stale operative guidance. Specifically:
   - lines ~41 and ~67-68 still document the dead REST capture funnel (get_metadata -> get_screenshot -> get_design_context) and 'raw get_metadata dumps' as the RATIFIED protocol. resonance-80bf rewrote design/manifest/README.md around the Desktop Bridge but deliberately did not touch the ADR, because an ADR records a ratified decision and amending it is this seed's job.
   - State the provenance requirement explicitly: canonical file + version id + content hash, read-only, and what to do when REST is unavailable.
   - Reconcile the metadata/ dump format: the ADR says 'raw get_metadata XML dumps', but REST is dead and dumps are now bridge-derived (see design/manifest/metadata/member-search-frames.md).
   Note: packages/ui/CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/add-ui-component-from-figma/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/verify/SKILL.md were already repointed at the manifest owners by resonance-80bf's document gate, so the ADR is the last stale REST reference.

Blocked on human action: obtaining view access to the canonical file and a working token. Escalate before starting.

title: infra: no-mistakes v1.40.3 custody deadlock — rebase writes objects to gate bare repo without advancing the branch ref
description:
Hit during Slice A step 3 (resonance-663d), no-mistakes v1.40.3 (d873960).

SYMPTOM: the pipeline's test step died on 'API Error: Connection closed mid-response' (a transport failure, not a test failure). Its rebase step had already replayed the branch commits onto a freshly-merged origin/main and written the resulting objects into the gate bare repo (~/.no-mistakes/repos/<id>.git), but never advanced the gate BRANCH REF to them. That wedges the two recovery paths against each other:
  - 'no-mistakes axi sync --recover' refuses with code 'blocked_recover_gate_diverged' (gate branch != preserved head)
  - 'no-mistakes axi run' refuses with next_action code 'recover_custody'
'--keep-local' does not bypass it; 'axi abort' is a no-op because the run is already terminal. There is no documented forward path.

WORKAROUND USED (needs review — it reaches into tool internals): verify the preserved commit is exclusively your own replayed work by confirming its tree equals your locally-rebased HEAD^{tree}, then complete the half-finished preservation with a compare-and-swap 'git update-ref' in the gate bare repo so it fails loudly if the ref moved. 'axi sync --recover --keep-local' then returns 'custody_returned' and a fresh run goes green. The gate was NOT bypassed and nothing was force-pushed.

WANTED: a supported recovery command for this state so agents never touch the gate's internal repo. v1.41.2 is available and may already fix it — the update was deliberately deferred during the fan-out because concurrent crewmates share the binary.

RELATED: resonance-3e21 (the older v1.31.2 'no previous run for branch' bug) is CLOSED — confirmed stale, v1.40.3 gates fresh treehouse branches cleanly. This is a different failure mode in the same custody machinery. Details also in the 'testing' mulch domain.

title: e2e-harness: harnessMailOverride() races on cold parallel auth requests, breaking the OTP read-back (onboarding-creator.spec.ts fails on main)
description:
PRE-EXISTING FAILURE ON MAIN, found by resonance-3f15 (Slice A step 6 e2e).

apps/web/lib/e2e-harness.ts harnessMailOverride() is not atomic:

  if (!store[HARNESS_MAIL_KEY]) {
    const { createFakeMail, observeLoginCodes } = await import("@resonance/auth/testing");
    const fake = createFakeMail();
    observeLoginCodes(fake);
    store[HARNESS_MAIL_KEY] = fake.port;
  }

There is an await between the guard and the assignment. The signup form fires TWO Better Auth
calls in parallel (signIn.magicLink + emailOtp.sendVerificationOtp, signup-form.tsx), so on a
cold dev server both requests pass the guard, both build a fake, and both call
observeLoginCodes(). One fake wins store[HARNESS_MAIL_KEY] (the port the auth instance actually
sends through); the other wins the process-wide observation slot registerObservedLoginCodes()
writes. peekLoginCode() then reads an array nothing ever pushes into, so
GET /api/test/last-otp returns {"otp":null} forever and the E2E cannot complete sign-in.

REPRO: pnpm --dir apps/web test:e2e -g "creator can sign up" on a cold server -> fails at the
OTP poll with 'Matcher error: received value must be a string'. A single direct POST to
/api/auth/email-otp/send-verification-otp works fine (no race). Issuing ONE warm auth request
(GET /api/auth/get-session) before the form makes it pass 3/3.

IMPACT: onboarding-creator.spec.ts 'creator can sign up, interview with Weave, generate + commit
a profile' is RED on main. apps/web/e2e/discovery.spec.ts carries a documented test-side warm-up
so the follow path can be verified; that warm-up should be deleted when this is fixed.

FIX: make the singleton construction race-free - build the fake synchronously behind a promise
pinned to globalThis (store the PROMISE, not the resolved port) so concurrent callers await the
same construction. Same shape applies to getWebAuth()'s store[HARNESS_AUTH_KEY] ??= createAuth(...).

Blast radius: apps/web/lib/e2e-harness.ts, apps/web/lib/auth.ts. Out of scope for resonance-3f15
(app source).

title: db: migration 0003 (follows table + status/tags indexes) is unapplied on the dev Neon database

CONSEQUENCE - this is a LIVE 500 on the dev environment, not just a test problem. When a viewer
IS signed in, searchCreatorProfiles() emits a correlated
  exists (select 1 from follows where follower_id =  and following_id = creator_profiles.user_id)
so ANY authenticated /discover search errors. Signed-out search is unaffected (the viewer-null
branch emits the literal 'unknown' and never names the table), which is why the anonymous paths
all pass.

FIX (one command, needs DATABASE_URL from apps/web/.env.local in the environment):
  pnpm --dir packages/db db:migrate

Blocked for the resonance-3f15 agent by the Claude Code permission classifier; needs a human or
an explicit Bash permission rule. Until it is applied, apps/web/e2e/discovery.spec.ts
'a signed-in member follows a creator and the state survives a reload' cannot pass, and plan
pl-bbca acceptance criterion 3 is NOT VERIFIED.
